newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis kill two Palestinians in Gaza clashes.
newsitem.headline: Israelis kill two Palestinians in Gaza clashes.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot dead two Palestinians and wounded more than 50 in clashes in the Gaza Strip on Thursday, hospital sources said.
A Jewish settler spokeswoman said six Israelis were injured, five of them soldiers.
The deaths raised to seven the number of Palestinians killed in two days of clashes with Israeli forces over Israeli policy in Jerusalem, holy to Moslems and Jews.
Shifa hospital in Gaza said Hani Moussa was shot dead in a clash near Kfar Darom Jewish settlement. The Israeli army said a lieutenant-colonel was moderately wounded by a gunshot.
A second Palestinian, Rizk Hawajreh, 32, was also shot dead, a doctor at Shifa said.
Palestinian hospital sources said some 50 Palestinians were wounded.
About 200 Palestinians pelted Israeli soldiers with stones at a checkpoint to the entrance of Netzarim settlement in the centre of the Gaza Strip.

The Israelis fired live ammunition, rubber bullets and teargas. Several Palestinian police fired back, witnesses said. Groups of demonstrators then skirted the checkpoint and threw stones at the settlement from surrounding fields.

At nearby Kfar Darom settlement gunfire could be heard in the background while Israel Radio broadcast a live interview with a woman settler there. She said the gunfire was coming from the Israeli side.

"Stones were thrown into the settlement. What you are hearing is about 200 metres (yards) from the house. Our children are in the houses...We have two wounded. One was taken to hospital by helicopter. The second is being treated on the spot," she said.
About 3,000 Jews live in Gaza settlements under Israeli army protection. Israel handed over most of the strip to self-rule under a peace deal in 1994. The strip is home to one million Palestinians.
